mapper.insert: INSERT INTO diagnosis (investigation_id, run_no, version_no, conclusion_type, primary_hypothesis_id, summary, impact_summary, termination_reason, created_at) VALUES (#{d.investigationId}, #{d.runNo}, #{d.versionNo}, #{d.conclusionType}, #{d.primaryHypothesisId}, #{d.summary}, #{d.impactSummary}, #{d.terminationReason}, #{d.createdAt})

INSERT INTO diagnosis_evidence_ref (diagnosis_id, evidence_id, created_at) VALUES
(#{diagnosisId}, #{evidenceId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, investigation_id, run_no, version_no, conclusion_type, primary_hypothesis_id, summary, impact_summary, termination_reason, created_at FROM diagnosis WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT evidence_id FROM diagnosis_evidence_ref WHERE diagnosis_id = #{diagnosisId} ORDER BY evidence_id
